description: Erection of a single storey detached outbuilding for the use as office / gym at the rear of the building
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ([TW34HS/PA01], [TW34HS/PA01 - Proposed], [Fire Equipment Storage Statement], [Fire Statement Form], Received: 07/03/2022, [TW34HS/PA02], Received: 04/04/2022) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 3 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall be used for the purpose as a gym/store/office/changing room and sauna or for any other purpose incidental to the residential use of the dwelling known as 17A Lampton Park Road, TW3 4HS and not as a self-contained dwelling nor as a business premises, nor shall any kitchen, bathroom, toilet or bedroom(s) be installed in the outbuilding without the permission of the Local Planning Authority obtained through the submission of a planning application.
